crossRefs.note: Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, view the land, including Jericho.”…
“Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul had certainly come.
translations.bsb: David sent out spies to verify that Saul had arrived.
translations.kjv: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul was come in very deed.
translations.asv: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul was come of a certainty.
